issue_request: FHIR-50859 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The original request was to make ImagingStudy.series.bodySite and ImagingSelection.bodySite BodyStructure-only references and remove laterality ambiguity, but the final Jira comments and referenced resolution page narrowed this to keeping bodySite as CodeableReference, removing ImagingStudy.series.laterality, and adding guidance on representing laterality through bodySite codes or BodyStructure.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation through the October 2025 imaging work. Commit c8ab401837 removed the ImagingStudy XR example laterality value; commit db64fafb15 removed ImagingStudy.series.laterality from the authoritative StructureDefinition, updated ImagingStudy and ImagingSelection bodySite definitions and DICOM mappings, and added Body Site and Laterality notes; PRs HL7/fhir#3735 and HL7/fhir#3729 merged that work.
additional_context: The July 2025 Zulip announcement records the original BodyStructure-only proposal and implementer concerns about search and patient-specific BodyStructure use. OO WGM minutes and the Jira comments record the later conclusion to keep CodeableReference, remove laterality, and provide guidance. FHIR-46918 is a supporting no-change decision that points to FHIR-50859 instead of adding ImagingSelection.laterality. FHIR-54747 is a later Submitted request for more detailed guidance, so it is not a final decision for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active build-scope source keeps ImagingStudy.series.bodySite and ImagingSelection.bodySite as CodeableReference elements targeting BodyStructure, has no authoritative ImagingStudy.series.laterality or ImagingSelection.laterality element, includes Body Site and Laterality notes for both resources, and maps DICOM Laterality (0020,0060) through bodySite. Remaining stale ImagingStudy.series.laterality mentions are confined to generated-looking SVG diagrams and BodyStructure examples, so they were not edited under the diagram guardrail.

related_jiras.note: Resolved No Change request to add ImagingSelection.laterality; its resolution says this approach is no longer being considered and points to FHIR-50859.

Submitted later request for more concrete guidance on when to use BodyStructure; it is unresolved and was not decided here.
Shared PR/example history in the October 2025 imaging branch, but it is a separate ImagingSelection subset issue already represented on the combined branch.
